opening: I had a kidney transplant from a living donor 20 years ago.
An 8-cm clear cell carcinoma, a kidney cancer, was recently found in my transplanted kidney.
Six days ago I had my first dose of nivolumab.

opening.text: I have a fever that started a day ago. I had a kidney transplant from a living donor 20 years ago, and an 8-cm clear cell carcinoma was recently found in my transplanted kidney. Six days ago I had my first dose of nivolumab, and I had my first dose of ipilimumab at the same time.

problems.fix: I had my first dose of ipilimumab at the same time, six days ago.
